verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 46.4
verses.english: Linked Discourses 46.4

verses.pali: 1. Pabbatavagga
verses.english: 1. Mountains

verses.pali: Vatthasutta
verses.english: Clothes

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā sāriputto sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time Venerable Sāriputta was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

verses.pali: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: There Sāriputta addressed the mendicants:

verses.pali: “āvuso bhikkhavo”ti.
verses.english: “Reverends, mendicants!”

verses.pali: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Reverend,” they replied.

verses.pali: Āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca:
verses.english: Sāriputta said this:

verses.pali: “Sattime, āvuso, bojjhaṅgā.
verses.english: “There are these seven awakening factors.

verses.pali: Katame satta?
verses.english: What seven?

verses.pali: Satisambojjhaṅgo, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo, vīriyasambojjhaṅgo, pītisambojjhaṅgo, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo, samādhisambojjhaṅgo, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo—
verses.english: The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity.

verses.pali: ime kho, āvuso, satta bojjhaṅgā.
verses.english: These are the seven awakening factors.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ khvāhaṁ, āvuso, sattannaṁ bojjhaṅgānaṁ yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi pubbaṇhasamayaṁ viharituṁ, tena tena bojjhaṅgena pubbaṇhasamayaṁ viharāmi;
verses.english: In the morning, I meditate on whichever of these seven awakening factors I want.

verses.pali: yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi majjhanhikaṁ samayaṁ viharituṁ, tena tena bojjhaṅgena majjhanhikaṁ samayaṁ viharāmi;
verses.english: At midday,

verses.pali: yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi sāyanhasamayaṁ viharituṁ, tena tena bojjhaṅgena sāyanhasamayaṁ viharāmi.
verses.english: and in the evening, I meditate on whichever of these seven awakening factors I want.

verses.pali: Satisambojjhaṅgo iti ce me, āvuso, hoti, ‘appamāṇo’ti me hoti, ‘susamāraddho’ti me hoti, tiṭṭhantañca naṁ ‘tiṭṭhatī’ti pajānāmi.
verses.english: If it’s the awakening factor of mindfulness, I know that it’s limitless and that it’s properly implemented. While it remains I understand that it remains.

verses.pali: Sacepi me cavati, ‘idappaccayā me cavatī’ti pajānāmi …pe…
verses.english: And if it subsides in me I understand the specific reason it subsides. …

verses.pali: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo iti ce me, āvuso, hoti, ‘appamāṇo’ti me hoti, ‘susamāraddho’ti me hoti, tiṭṭhantañca naṁ ‘tiṭṭhatī’ti pajānāmi.
verses.english: If it’s the awakening factor of equanimity, I know that it’s limitless and that it’s properly implemented. While it remains I understand that it remains.

verses.pali: Sacepi me cavati, ‘idappaccayā me cavatī’ti pajānāmi.
verses.english: And if it subsides I understand the specific reason it subsides.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, rañño vā rājamahāmattassa vā nānārattānaṁ dussānaṁ dussakaraṇḍako pūro assa.
verses.english: Suppose that a ruler or their chief minister had a chest full of garments of different colors.

verses.pali: So yaññadeva dussayugaṁ ākaṅkheyya pubbaṇhasamayaṁ pārupituṁ, taṁ tadeva dussayugaṁ pubbaṇhasamayaṁ pārupeyya;
verses.english: In the morning, they’d don whatever pair of garments they wanted.

verses.pali: yaññadeva dussayugaṁ ākaṅkheyya majjhanhikaṁ samayaṁ pārupituṁ, taṁ tadeva dussayugaṁ majjhanhikaṁ samayaṁ pārupeyya;
verses.english: At midday,

verses.pali: yaññadeva dussayugaṁ ākaṅkheyya sāyanhasamayaṁ pārupituṁ, taṁ tadeva dussayugaṁ sāyanhasamayaṁ pārupeyya.
verses.english: and in the evening, they’d don whatever pair of garments they wanted.

verses.pali: Evameva khvāhaṁ, āvuso, imesaṁ sattannaṁ bojjhaṅgānaṁ yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi pubbaṇhasamayaṁ viharituṁ, tena tena bojjhaṅgena pubbaṇhasamayaṁ viharāmi;
verses.english: In the same way, in the morning,

verses.pali: yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi majjhanhikaṁ samayaṁ viharituṁ, tena tena bojjhaṅgena majjhanhikaṁ samayaṁ viharāmi;
verses.english: at midday,

verses.pali: yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi sāyanhasamayaṁ viharituṁ, tena tena bojjhaṅgena sāyanhasamayaṁ viharāmi.
verses.english: and in the evening, I meditate on whichever of these seven awakening factors I want.

verses.pali: Satisambojjhaṅgo iti ce me, āvuso, hoti, ‘appamāṇo’ti me hoti, ‘susamāraddho’ti me hoti, tiṭṭhantañca naṁ ‘tiṭṭhatī’ti pajānāmi.
verses.english: If it’s the awakening factor of mindfulness, I know that it’s limitless and that it’s properly implemented. While it remains I understand that it remains.

verses.pali: Sacepi me cavati, ‘idappaccayā me cavatī’ti pajānāmi …pe…
verses.english: And if it subsides I understand the specific reason it subsides. …

verses.pali: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo iti ce me, āvuso, hoti, ‘appamāṇo’ti me hoti, ‘susamāraddho’ti me hoti, tiṭṭhantañca naṁ ‘tiṭṭhatī’ti pajānāmi.
verses.english: If it’s the awakening factor of equanimity, I know that it’s limitless and that it’s properly implemented. While it remains I understand that it remains.

verses.pali: Sacepi me cavati, ‘idappaccayā me cavatī’ti pajānāmī”ti.
verses.english: And if it subsides I understand the specific reason it subsides.”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
